target.model: Vacuum Schwarzschild interior via Kantowski-Sachs WDW minisuperspace
target.scope_note: Audit the path from the verified classical Schwarzschild/KS bridge to clock choice, physical inner product, factor ordering and mass/curvature observables without treating minisuperspace consistency as full quantum gravity. This target is permanently minisuperspace-scoped and cannot be promoted to full quantum GR even if every internal gate passes.

obligations.requirement: Independently derive the Schwarzschild-interior to KS classical bridge and match the canonical constraint to repository WDW variables.
Verify that T and the areal-radius variable Y=x+T are admissible classical clocks on the target branch and that the same Dirac state gives consistent KG flux on T=const and Y=const slices.
obligations.note: This closes classical/same-state slice admissibility, not an independently deparametrized Y-time quantum theory.

obligations.requirement: Define the continuum domain/zero-mode prescription for the deparametrized Y-clock Hamiltonian K_Y=(p_X^2+exp(-2X))/(2p_X) and compare the independently quantized Y-clock theory with the same Dirac state.
obligations.note: The finite-box p_X minimum approaches zero and ||p_X^-1|| grows rapidly under box expansion, although the audited packet-specific inverse norm remains finite.

obligations.requirement: Map the same positive-frequency finite-box state and observables between the L2 and KG representations using the explicit H^(±1/2) isometry.
obligations.note: Finite-box KG norm and mapped x/r observables agree to numerical precision.

obligations.requirement: Specify the continuum positive-frequency physical-KG Hilbert completion and the zero-threshold domains relevant to the same-state L2↔KG map.
obligations.note: The physical positive-frequency KG space is the energy-norm completion of D(H^(1/2)); S=sqrt(h/2)H^(-1/2) extends by completion to a unitary map from L2. H^(-1/2) remains unbounded as an ordinary-L2 operator, but the audited Gaussian has c(k)=O(k) and lies in its ordinary-L2 domain.

obligations.requirement: Test an explicit formally symmetric ordering/measure family with the same principal symbol using the same physical initial state identification.

Construct a positive-frequency-preserving mass Dirac observable that is symmetric in the physical KG representation, has the classical Schwarzschild mass principal symbol and a controlled continuum quadratic-form domain.
obligations.note: A concrete finite-box candidate M_D(T)=U M0 U† is declared for downstream audits; its same-Wigner semiclassical error decreases over the audited h-family, while continuum closure and unique ordering selection remain open. Exact affine covariance is excluded as an ordering-uniqueness criterion on the semibounded positive-frequency sector; this does not settle q_M closability.

obligations.requirement: Using the declared mass Dirac candidate, identify at least one domain-safe positive quantum Kretschmann ordering with regulator-stable quadratic form on the audited state.
obligations.note: The three declared positive forms all grow monotonically by more than 60 log10 decades from right=12 to 32 at T=2. FAIL is scoped to these explicit-radius forms and is not a no-go theorem for every nonlocal relational curvature observable.

obligations.requirement: Show finite regulator removal for the inverse-radius moments needed by the chosen curvature quadratic form.

expect.full_unbounded_moment_finite_convergence: FAILED for q=2,4,6 in this regulator study; no finite value reported

obligations.note: The original inverse-radius tail audit fails, and the selected mass candidate does not restore regulator stability for the three audited positive Kretschmann forms.

obligations.requirement: Recover the classical Schwarzschild interior, areal radius and mass observable.
Demonstrate a common-state semiclassical limit for the selected clock, physical inner product, ordering and mass/curvature observables.
obligations.note: The declared mass candidate approaches the classical mass expectation of the same Gaussian Wigner ensemble under the h-scaled grid sequence. The clock/domain/curvature parts of a common-state semiclassical limit remain incomplete.

obligations.requirement: Reproduce the stored KS quantum audit diagnostics and preserve negative/partial results.
Reproduce the physical mass candidate, same-state Y-clock flux and selected-mass Kretschmann audit while preserving scoped PARTIAL/FAIL decisions.
Compile scoped labels from the KS obligations without promoting around partial/failed gates.
